import argparse
import os
import json
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['Poster_Link'].notna().all()
    assert df['Poster_Link'].astype(str).str.startswith(('http://', 'https://')).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    r = df['IMDB_Rating']
    assert r.notna().all()
    assert ((r >= 0.0) & (r <= 10.0)).all()
    r10 = r * 10.0
    assert np.isclose(r10, np.round(r10), atol=1e-8).all()
    assert (r >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.80
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    m = df['Meta_score']
    assert m.notna().mean() >= 0.80
    m_present = m.dropna()
    assert m_present.between(0, 100).all()
    assert np.isclose(m_present % 1, 0, atol=1e-8).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    mask = df['Meta_score'].notna()
    if mask.sum() > 1:
        meta_norm_tmp = df.loc[mask, 'Meta_score'] / 10.0
        imdb_tmp = df.loc[mask, 'IMDB_Rating']
        corr = imdb_tmp.corr(meta_norm_tmp)
        assert not np.isnan(corr)
        assert corr > 0.3
        diff = (imdb_tmp - meta_norm_tmp).abs()
        assert (diff <= 2.0).mean() >= 0.80
        high_mask = (df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 8.0) & mask
        if high_mask.sum() > 0:
            assert (df.loc[high_mask, 'Meta_score'] >= 70).mean() >= 0.70
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    host_ok_ratio = df['Poster_Link'].astype(str).str.contains(r'(amazon\.com|imdb\.com)', regex=True).mean()
    assert host_ok_ratio >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['Runtime'].astype(str).str.match(r'^\d+ min$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    runtime_minutes = df['Runtime'].str.extract(r'(\d+)')[0].astype(int)
    df['runtime_min'] = runtime_minutes

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['runtime_min'].between(45, 240).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['runtime_min'].between(80, 180).mean() >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    g = df['Gross']
    assert g.notna().mean() >= 0.80
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    g_present = df['Gross'].dropna().astype(str)
    assert g_present.str.match(r'^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*$').all()
    g_parsed = g_present.str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype('int64')
    assert (g_parsed > 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    cert = df['Certificate']
    assert cert.notna().mean() >= 0.85
    cert_present = cert.dropna().astype(str)
    allowed_cert = set(['U', 'UA', 'A', 'G', 'PG', 'PG-13', 'R', 'NC-17', 'Not Rated', 'Unrated', 'Approved', 'Passed', 'TV-G', 'TV-PG', 'TV-14', 'TV-MA'])
    assert cert_present.eq(cert_present.str.strip()).all()
    assert cert_present.isin(allowed_cert).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    allowed_genres = set(['Action', 'Adventure', 'Animation', 'Biography', 'Comedy', 'Crime', 'Documentary', 'Drama', 'Family', 'Fantasy', 'Film-Noir', 'History', 'Horror', 'Music', 'Musical', 'Mystery', 'Romance', 'Sci-Fi', 'Sport', 'Thriller', 'War', 'Western'])
    def _check_genre(gstr):
        if pd.isna(gstr):
            return False
        parts = str(gstr).split(', ')
        if not (1 <= len(parts) <= 3):
            return False
        if len(set(parts)) != len(parts):
            return False
        return all(p in allowed_genres for p in parts)
    assert df['Genre'].apply(_check_genre).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['gross_value'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Gross'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
    df['gross_millions'] = df['gross_value'] / 1_000_000.0

    df['meta_norm'] = df['Meta_score'] / 10.0
    df['rating_display'] = df['IMDB_Rating'].map(lambda x: f"{x:.1f}")

    df['quality_score'] = np.where(df['Meta_score'].notna(), 0.6 * df['IMDB_Rating'] + 0.4 * df['meta_norm'], df['IMDB_Rating'])

    df['genres_list'] = df['Genre'].str.split(', ')
    expanded = df.explode('genres_list')
    expanded = expanded.rename(columns={'genres_list': 'Genre_Token'})
    expanded = expanded[expanded['Certificate'].notna()]

    sort_cols = ['quality_score', 'No_of_Votes'] if 'No_of_Votes' in expanded.columns else ['quality_score']

    carousels = {}
    for (genre_token, cert_value), grp in expanded.groupby(['Genre_Token', 'Certificate'], dropna=False):
        grp_sorted = grp.sort_values(by=sort_cols, ascending=[False] * len(sort_cols)).head(12)
        items = []
        for _, row in grp_sorted.iterrows():
            item = {
                'title': str(row['Series_Title']),
                'poster_url': str(row['Poster_Link']),
                'rating': float(row['IMDB_Rating']),
                'rating_display': str(row['rating_display']),
                'meta_score': None if pd.isna(row['Meta_score']) else int(row['Meta_score']),
                'runtime_min': int(row['runtime_min']),
                'gross': None if pd.isna(row['gross_value']) else int(row['gross_value']),
                'quality_score': float(round(row['quality_score'], 3)),
                'released_year': int(row['Released_Year']) if not pd.isna(row['Released_Year']) else None
            }
            items.append(item)
        key = f"{genre_token}|{cert_value}"
        carousels[key] = items

    carousels_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'carousels_by_genre_certificate.json')
    with open(carousels_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(carousels, f, ensure_ascii=False)

    cleaned = df.copy()
    cleaned_out_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Poster_Link', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'Genre', 'IMDB_Rating',
        'Meta_score', 'No_of_Votes', 'runtime_min', 'gross_value', 'gross_millions', 'quality_score'
    ]
    cleaned[cleaned_out_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'cleaned_catalog.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    expanded = df.explode('genres_list')
    expanded = expanded.rename(columns={'genres_list': 'Genre_Token'})
    expanded = expanded[expanded['Certificate'].notna()]

    sort_cols = ['quality_score', 'No_of_Votes'] if 'No_of_Votes' in expanded.columns else ['quality_score']

    carousels = {}
    for (genre_token, cert_value), grp in expanded.groupby(['Genre_Token', 'Certificate'], dropna=False):
        grp_sorted = grp.sort_values(by=sort_cols, ascending=[False] * len(sort_cols)).head(12)
        items = []
        for _, row in grp_sorted.iterrows():
            item = {
                'title': str(row['Series_Title']),
                'poster_url': str(row['Poster_Link']),
                'rating': float(row['IMDB_Rating']),
                'rating_display': str(row['rating_display']),
                'meta_score': None if pd.isna(row['Meta_score']) else int(row['Meta_score']),
                'runtime_min': int(row['runtime_min']),
                'gross': None if pd.isna(row['gross_value']) else int(row['gross_value']),
                'quality_score': float(round(row['quality_score'], 3)),
                'released_year': int(row['Released_Year']) if not pd.isna(row['Released_Year']) else None
            }
            items.append(item)
        key = f"{genre_token}|{cert_value}"
        carousels[key] = items

    carousels_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'carousels_by_genre_certificate.json')
    with open(carousels_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(carousels, f, ensure_ascii=False)

    cleaned = df.copy()
    cleaned_out_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Poster_Link', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'Genre', 'IMDB_Rating',
        'Meta_score', 'No_of_Votes', 'runtime_min', 'gross_value', 'gross_millions', 'quality_score'
    ]
    cleaned[cleaned_out_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'cleaned_catalog.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
